cycle-09b9f993614f.lesson_insight: Every new required AGENTS.md section must be registered in REQUIRED_SECTIONS in tests/test_agents_structure.py in the same commit, with a targeted pytest run confirming the heading resolves; an unregistered section is not yet standing policy and can be removed without tripping the gate.
cycle-09b9f993614f.lesson_problem: In reflection-521b6562e356, a cycle added a new required section to AGENTS.md but left REQUIRED_SECTIONS in tests/test_agents_structure.py untouched, so the new standing instruction had no structural test guarding it and could be dropped in a later cycle without any gate failure. The omission was only caught by manual review, not by the test suite.
cycle-09b9f993614f.lesson_solution: Whenever a new required section is introduced in AGENTS.md, add its exact heading to REQUIRED_SECTIONS in tests/test_agents_structure.py in the same commit, then run python3 -m pytest tests/test_agents_structure.py to confirm the new entry resolves to a present heading. Treat the AGENTS.md edit and the test registration as one atomic change: a section that is not registered is not yet standing policy.

cycle-260bd269e5a0.task_title: Record lesson in lessons.yaml on using sys.stdlib_module_names for standard library detection
cycle-260bd269e5a0.lesson_insight: Prefer constant-time membership checks against sys.stdlib_module_names over dynamic import or sys.path inspection when classifying modules as standard library vs third-party; reserve importlib.util.find_spec for cases that also require importability confirmation.
cycle-260bd269e5a0.lesson_problem: In cycle-bdea8c5fbdc2, detecting whether a module is part of the standard library required dynamic inspection (importing modules or walking sys.path), which burned tool iterations and exhausted the cycle's turn budget before the change was committed.
cycle-260bd269e5a0.lesson_solution: Check membership against sys.stdlib_module_names, a frozenset of all standard library module names available since Python 3.10: `import sys; is_stdlib = name in sys.stdlib_module_names`. For submodules (e.g. 'json.decoder'), check the top-level package name. Combine with importlib.util.find_spec only when you also need to confirm the module is importable in the current environment. This is a constant-time set lookup with no import side effects and no filesystem traversal.
cycle-260bd269e5a0.title: Record lesson in lessons.yaml on using sys.stdlib_module_names for standard library detection

cycle-d44ed220091b.task_title: Record lesson in lessons.yaml on avoiding repetitive searches for new feature terms
cycle-d44ed220091b.lesson_insight: When a task introduces a new feature term or symbol, at most one targeted grep confirms absence; further identical or similar searches are wasted iterations. After confirming the term is new, proceed directly to reading the designated target file and making the edit rather than re-searching the codebase.
cycle-d44ed220091b.lesson_problem: When a task requests a new feature or term that does not yet exist in the codebase, subagents repeatedly re-run grep and list_dir sweeps searching for the term, burning tool iterations on searches that will always return empty. The term is new by definition, so no existing match is possible, and each redundant search wastes a full iteration of the cycle budget.
cycle-d44ed220091b.lesson_solution: When a task names a new feature, term, or symbol that is not yet present in the codebase, run at most one targeted grep to confirm absence, then stop searching and proceed directly to reading the designated target file and making the edit. Do not re-run the same or similar searches expecting a different result. If the first grep returns empty, treat that as confirmation the feature is new and move to the edit phase immediately.

cycle-90931e43a3db.lesson_problem: In cycle-90931e43a3db, a markdown catalog index consistency test resolved every relative link in the index against a single base (the memory/ directory), so links written in the other common format — repository-relative ('memory/facts/...') instead of directory-relative ('facts/...') — were reported as missing files even though the target exists on disk. The test failed on a valid index purely because of the link's path format.
cycle-90931e43a3db.lesson_solution: When validating relative markdown links in a catalog index (e.g. memory/index.md), resolve each link against both candidate bases — the index file's own directory and the repository root — and treat the link as valid if either resolution yields an existing file. Only report a link as missing when neither candidate path exists. This makes the consistency check format-agnostic for the two relative path conventions used in the catalog.

reflection-e13f1cd0f155.lesson_insight: When repo-wide test suites time out on the constrained host, fall back to targeted test execution (paired test module or script --test flag) to validate scoped changes within the cycle budget.
reflection-e13f1cd0f155.lesson_problem: In reflection-e13f1cd0f155, a full repo-wide pytest sweep exceeded the available time on the slow i386 host, leaving the scoped change unverified before the cycle budget ran out.
reflection-e13f1cd0f155.lesson_solution: When repo-wide test suites time out, validate scoped changes via targeted pytest on the paired test module (e.g. python3 -m pytest tests/test_<changed>.py) or the script's own --test flag, and record the full-suite timeout in concrete_next_action rather than re-running the sweep.

LESS-REF-1767b3d47ede-ffe2.lesson_insight: Use standard POSIX shell exit status captures (`$?`) rather than bash-specific variables like `${PIPESTATUS[0]}` when executing commands in POSIX `/bin/sh` environments.
LESS-REF-1767b3d47ede-ffe2.lesson_problem: In cycle-1767b3d47ede, running `echo "EXIT: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"` triggered `/bin/sh: 1: Bad substitution` with exit code 2 before switching back to `$?`.
LESS-REF-1767b3d47ede-ffe2.lesson_solution: Use standard POSIX shell exit status captures (`$?`) rather than bash-specific variables like `${PIPESTATUS[0]}` when executing commands in POSIX `/bin/sh` environments.
